ladderNote: Trumps rank differently: the jack (20) and the nine (14) sit above the ace.
sequenceNote: Sequences run in NATURAL rank order (7-8-9-10-J-Q-K-A), not in point order.
bidNotice: Take the turn-up suit as trump?
bidFreeNotice: Name any suit you like — except the turn-up suit both of you refused.
schmeissNotice: Your opponent offers to throw the deal in. Refuse and THEY become the maker.
playNotice: Following, trumping and overtrumping are all compulsory; only legal cards can be chosen.
beteLine: Bete: the maker failed to score more, so the whole hand goes to the opponent.
madeLine: The maker scored more. Both sides keep their own points.
sequenceNobody: Sequences: an exact tie, so nobody scores
dixLine: The trump seven was exchanged for the turn-up

tutorial.info: The deal number, the target and the trump suit are shown here.
tutorial.players: Game scores and this deal's points. The opponent's hand stays hidden until the settlement.
tutorial.hand: Your hand. Following, trumping and overtrumping are compulsory, so illegal cards cannot be chosen.
tutorial.actions: While bidding, take the trump suit or pass. In play, pick a card and press Play.
tutorial.resetButton: Reset the game at any time with this button.
